notes.title: Update notes 3/22
notes.notes:
Minor small bug fixes

Add notification that you have a new weapon in your inventory when you're in the upgrade menu

notes.title: Update for March 16, 2024
notes.notes:
A few changes:


 Fixed a bug that gave the player 4x more health than they should've had
 Added twitch integration - set it up through the options menu. Controller not supported yet.
 Added backup lights for the car
 Increased threat level for the Apocalypse phase
 Various little fixes

notes.title: Update Notes for March 11
notes.notes:
Patch changes


 Rebalanced how difficulties scale
 Improved performance
 Revamped UI logic for improved stability
 Added early version of controller/Steam Deck support
 Changed zombie spawn logic to be less of a ball
 Removed early Fire Truck spawns on easy difficulty
 Added controls help in options menu - only supports keyboard for now
 Improved reward messages for streaks
 Added cloud sync for stats
 Vehicles now run zombies over instead of getting pushed around by them
 Weapons now upgrade globally instead of individually


Upcoming

 Basic Twitch integration - allows viewers to spawn vehicles with their names on them. May the best viewer win.
 More weapons
 More vehicles

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Quick fix for a bug found in the starting difficulty. Won't be overwhelmed off the bat anymore!
